[[File:Bear icon.png|left]]
'''Grizzly bears''' are a type of [[bear]] found in the forests of [[Gielinor]]. Although relatively weak, they could be very dangerous to a low-level player. They can be given as a [[Slayer assignment]]. Its [[Bear pelt|pelt]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]] during the [[Fur 'n Seek]] quest.

The most populous area of grizzly bears is at the [[Legends' Guild south-west mine]], east of [[Manor Farm]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Havenhythe Out Now|date=23 March 2026}}
** Added to [[Highweald Forest]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Relic Presets & February Mini Strike - This Week In RuneScape|date=10 February 2025}}
** The unbearable sleuth of 18 grizzly bears near the [[Legends' Guild]] has been halved to the simple bear necessities.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=WildyWyrm Flash Event and Valentines - This Week In RuneScape|date=5 February 2024}}
** Grizzly Bears and [[Black bear|Black Bears]] no longer appear purple when textures are disabled.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Community Hitlist and Necromancy Embargo - This Week In RuneScape|date=22 January 2024}}
** Black bears and grizzly bears, including their [[grizzly bear cub|cubs]], have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=New Skill: Necromancy - This Week In RuneScape|date=7 August 2023}}
** Grizzly bears' weakness was changed from [[air spells]] to [[water spells]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=This Week In RuneScape: The Battle Of The Monolith continues!|date=7 June 2021}}
** Grizzly bear death animations have been fixed.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape - 26/10/20#Patch Notes|date=26 October 2020}}
** Monsters with multiple variants will now consistently spawn as those variants when newly placed in the [[Sunken Pyramid|Personal Slayer Dungeon]].
*** This includes bears.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (21 August 2012)|date=21 August 2012}}
** Bears have animations again.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (12 October 2010)|date=12 October 2010}}
** Due to the supernatural disturbances in the [[Charm sprite Hunter area|charm sprite hunting area]], players should note that the [[wolf|wolves]], bears, and [[giant spider]]s that used to roam this area have migrated. The wolves can now be found north-west of the [[Battlefield]]; the bears now live east of the [[Legends' Guild]]; and the giant spiders have scurried over to the jungle south-west of the [[Feldip Hills]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Plague City Part 4 Released|date=20 September 2004}}
** New level variant of grizzly bears added to game.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}
